### Properties

#### SelectionStrategy

```text
PPDS.Dataverse.Pooling.ConnectionSelectionStrategy SelectionStrategy { get; set; }
```

Gets or sets the connection selection strategy. Default: ThrottleAware


#### DisableAffinityCookie

```text
System.Boolean DisableAffinityCookie { get; set; }
```

Gets or sets a value indicating whether to disable the affinity cookie for load distribution. Default: true (disabled)


Remarks: CRITICAL: With EnableAffinityCookie = true (SDK default), all requests route to a single backend node. Disabling the affinity cookie can increase performance by at least one order of magnitude. Only set to false (enable affinity) for low-volume scenarios or when session affinity is required.

#### EnableValidation

```text
System.Boolean EnableValidation { get; set; }
```

Gets or sets a value indicating whether background connection validation is enabled. Default: true


#### Enabled

```text
System.Boolean Enabled { get; set; }
```

Gets or sets a value indicating whether connection pooling is enabled. Default: true


#### ValidateOnCheckout

```text
System.Boolean ValidateOnCheckout { get; set; }
```

Gets or sets a value indicating whether to validate connection health on checkout. When true, connections are checked for IsReady, age, and validity before being returned. Default: true


#### MaxConnectionRetries

```text
System.Int32 MaxConnectionRetries { get; set; }
```

Gets or sets the maximum number of retry attempts for auth/connection failures. When a connection fails due to auth or connectivity issues, operations will retry with a new connection up to this many times. Default: 2


#### MaxPoolSize

```text
System.Int32 MaxPoolSize { get; set; }
```

Gets or sets a fixed total pool size override. When 0 (default), uses 52 × connection count (Microsoft&#x27;s per-user limit). Set to a positive value to enforce a specific total pool size. Default: 0 (use per-connection sizing at 52 per user).


Remarks: The pool semaphore is sized at 52 × connections to respect Microsoft&#x27;s hard limit. Actual parallelism is controlled by RecommendedDegreesOfParallelism from the server.

#### MaxRetryAfterTolerance

```text
System.Nullable`1<System.TimeSpan> MaxRetryAfterTolerance { get; set; }
```

Gets or sets the maximum acceptable Retry-After duration before failing. Default: null (wait indefinitely for throttle to clear). If set, throws PPDS.Dataverse.Resilience.ServiceProtectionException when all connections are throttled and the shortest wait exceeds this value.


Remarks: Throttle waits are typically 30 seconds to 5 minutes. Most bulk operations should wait indefinitely (the default) since throttles are temporary and will clear. Only set a tolerance for interactive scenarios where responsiveness matters more than completion.

#### AcquireTimeout

```text
System.TimeSpan AcquireTimeout { get; set; }
```

Gets or sets the maximum time to wait for a connection. With proper pool-managed concurrency, tasks queue on the semaphore and this timeout should rarely be hit. Set high enough to accommodate large imports with many batches queuing for connections. Default: 120 seconds


#### MaxIdleTime

```text
System.TimeSpan MaxIdleTime { get; set; }
```

Gets or sets the maximum connection idle time before eviction. Default: 5 minutes


#### MaxLifetime

```text
System.TimeSpan MaxLifetime { get; set; }
```

Gets or sets the maximum connection lifetime. Set within OAuth token validity window for stable long-running scenarios. Default: 60 minutes


#### ValidationInterval

```text
System.TimeSpan ValidationInterval { get; set; }
```

Gets or sets the interval for background validation. Default: 1 minute
